name: Spicy Italian Sausage & Mixed Pepper Skillet
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the sausages into 1-inch pieces.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage and pan-fry, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, seed and slice bell peppers into thin strips. Transfer to a medium bowl.

Halve jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Thinly slice and add to the bowl with the bell peppers. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince garlic. Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half moons; add both to the bowl with the peppers.
When the sausages are done, remove to a plate.
Return the skillet to medium heat, add additional oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and browned, about 10 minutes.
Stir sausages into the skillet and continue to cook until heated through, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide sausage-pepper skillet between plates and enjoy!
author: Mealime
